title: TechnicalAnalysisAgentInput
description: Pre-market snapshot for a single ticker. All fields are provided by the data pipeline / market-data API. Fields are grouped by TIER: Tier-1 (required) are the trusted 'static anchors' plus the technical levels the agent CANNOT reliably recompute at pre-market and MUST NOT fabricate. Tier-2 (recommended) sharpen the analysis; if omitted the agent may web-search or set the corresponding output to null with reduced confidence. Tier-3 (optional) are context enrichers.

symbol.description: TIER-1. Uppercase stock ticker symbol. Ground truth. Do not alter.

as_of.description: TIER-1. ISO-8601 timestamp (with timezone) at which this snapshot was captured, e.g. 2026-07-01T13:15:00Z. Anchors all 'recency' reasoning.

session.description: TIER-1. Trading session when the snapshot was captured. This agent is designed for 'pre_market'.

prev_close.description: TIER-1 STATIC ANCHOR. Prior regular-session official closing price. The baseline for gap % and change calculations.

pre_market_price.description: TIER-1 STATIC ANCHOR. Latest pre-market traded price. Do not verify/fetch/override.

pre_market_change_pct.description: TIER-1 STATIC ANCHOR. Pre-market % change vs prev_close (e.g. 1.34 = +1.34%). Must be internally consistent with prev_close and pre_market_price.

pre_market_volume.description: TIER-1 STATIC ANCHOR. Cumulative pre-market shares traded (absolute integer, not '781K').

market_cap.description: TIER-1 STATIC ANCHOR. Market capitalization in USD (absolute number, e.g. 15570000000, not '15.57B').

atr.description: TIER-1 STATIC ANCHOR. Average True Range with explicit period and timeframe so stop-loss and position sizing are unambiguous.

value.description: ATR value in price units (same currency as price).

timeframe.description: Bar timeframe the ATR was computed on. '1d' ATR sets the day's expected range; intraday ATR sizes intraday stops.

prev_day_high.description: TIER-1. Prior regular-session high. Primary intraday resistance / breakout reference. Cannot be reliably web-searched intraday.

prev_day_low.description: TIER-1. Prior regular-session low. Primary intraday support / breakdown reference.

avg_daily_volume_20d.description: TIER-1. 20-day average daily volume (absolute shares). Denominator/baseline for relative-volume reasoning.

benchmark.description: TIER-1. Index reference (typically SPY) required to compute Relative Strength. Without it, RS must be reported null.

pre_market_change_pct.description: Benchmark pre-market % change vs its prev_close.

premarket_high.description: TIER-2. Pre-market session high so far. Key opening-range / sweep level.

premarket_low.description: TIER-2. Pre-market session low so far. Key opening-range / sweep level.

vwap_prev_session.description: TIER-2. Volume-weighted average price of the prior regular session. Anchor for VWAP-reclaim logic (today's session VWAP does not exist yet at pre-market).

ema.description: TIER-2. Daily EMA values used for HTF bias determination. Set members to null if unavailable.

rsi_14_daily.description: TIER-2. 14-period daily RSI (0-100) for momentum context.

volume_profile.description: TIER-2. Prior-session (or composite) volume-at-price map. NOT reliably web-searchable — if absent, volume-profile output MUST be null.

poc.description: Point of Control (price of highest traded volume).

lookback_sessions.description: Number of sessions the profile aggregates.

rvol_premarket.description: TIER-2. Pre-computed time-adjusted relative volume: cumulative pre-market volume up to as_of divided by the N-day average cumulative volume to the same clock-time (N=10..20). Provide this so the agent does not estimate RVOL from data it lacks.

float_shares.description: TIER-3. Free-float share count. Gives meaning to short_float_pct and squeeze potential.

next_earnings_date.description: TIER-3. Next scheduled earnings date (YYYY-MM-DD) or null. Used to flag event risk and avoid trading into a print.

short_data.description: TIER-3. Short-interest fundamentals. These update on an exchange schedule (bi-monthly / quarterly), so pass the most recent reported values with as_of dates rather than expecting live web verification.

as_of_date.description: Report date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the short/institutional figures.

mc_vol_ratio.description: TIER-3. Pipeline-provided liquidity ratio (definition set upstream). Context only; do not treat as a tradable signal on its own.
